newsitem.title: CHINA: Daimler unit in $95.5 mln China venture.
newsitem.headline: Daimler unit in $95.5 mln China venture.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG's Mercedes-Benz AG unit and China's Yangzhou Motor Coach Co have agreed to set up a $95.5 million joint venture to produce tourist buses and chassis, Yangzhou Motor officials said on Thursday.

Helmut Werner, chief executive officer of Mercedes-Benz, will visit Beijing to sign an agreement on September 16 to set up the Yaxing-Benz Ltd in Yangzhou city in the eastern Chinese province of Jiangsu, Yangzhou Motor officials told Reuters by telephone.
Mercedes and Yangzhou will each hold a 50 percent stake in the venture, which will produce 7,000 tourist buses and 12,000 chassis annually for the domestic market, they said.
Mercedes has pledged to transfer technology to the venture, which would take over one of Yangzhou's plants, the officials said. They declined to provide further details.
